newsitem.title: USA: Omni doesn't meet AMEX listing requirements.
newsitem.headline: Omni doesn't meet AMEX listing requirements.

text.p: Omni Multimedia Gorup Inc said on Thursday that it presently does not meet the American Stock Exchange's continual listing guidelines, noting that the company has an accumulared deficit and a net working capital deficiency.
Omni also said in a statement it is in arrears on a number of loans and lease payments.
As of June 28, 1997, the company had cash and cash equivalents of $73,844.
The company said it is actively addressing the continued operating losses and deficiencies and it expects sales from its OMNI and 4CDs to trend upward.
The company said the growing sales trend of its OMNI and 4CDs products could help the company break even in September or post profits in the last two quarters of its year ending March 1998.
